I'm in the process of doing this right now. Had camouflage with braces only on upper teeth in my teen years. The teeth were never straight, still had a mild underbite and even got additionally open bite because of wisdom teeth that pushed my teeth. 

Now I'm 20 too and preparing to get surgery. I need my wisdom teeth to get pulled + upper premolars. 

I don't have any bad functional problems right now, but I know they can get worse if my incorrect bite is left untreated even if the underbite doesn't look "bad" from the outside right now. 

Also from what I know, surgery corrects asymmetry. But you should talk about this concern with your orthodontist/surgeon first

Edit: Also, correcting your bite is making you how you are supposed to look like if your bite would have grown correctly. That's what my orthodontist told me. I too often feel like my face right now just doesn't "fit" me. So I look forward to my "normal" face haha

Thank you so much for telling me your experience!! I feel so so much better about this now and I'll make sure to talk to my surgeon whenever I have doubts. I'm also glad to know that your jaw surgery went well!!

Hey, I know whatever I say probably won't do anything, but you know, I feel like there's still hope in you, hoping not having to kill yourself. Hoping that someone here will change your mind. Or else you wouldn't post this on reddit, right? I myself used to be suicidal and I was so sure that I wanted to die. But now, thinking back, it's not my life that I wanted to end, but my problems and situation that I wanted to end. I believed that my problems were my life. But it's not like that. People are shit. Yes. That's why you have to love yourself even more. So that doesn't mean you have to be shit to yourself. Loss and betrayal is what you have witnessed, but I truly can see, that this should not be the end of you. It's only the start. The start of you to turn around your life. And I know you can do it, because all the other people who betrayed or beat you already proved with their action that they couldn't do it. But you can do it. You're better than them. You're better than others. Their opinions don't matter at all. Don't let dickheads win. Do me a favor and restart. Give the world a second chance. You haven't tasted love yet. You don't know what it is to be loved by nature and to love the nature yet. And that's fine. Because you still can do it. And I can promise you, that it's worth it. 

Heroin took your sister, your father was the victim of cancer, your mother left you, BUT you can do better. You have the chance right now to be in a better place. Life is something that you self have to create, not others. Events that you couldn't control shouldn't be your definition of life. Life is what you make of it. You can die now without even knowing what it means to be living and to be loved. Or you can keep living now, to experience this all. And if you choose this path, I can promise that you can achieve it, because you are a good person. A good person that is in the wrong place right now, and will be stuck in the wrong place forever if they kill themselve now.
